shortTitle: Going to UITH or the colleges? How to get there
title: Getting to UITH and the Old / New College
body: UITH and the Old and New College sites are not on the Main Campus, so you cannot walk there. You will need a cab. From the Main Campus:
tips: Not sure which motor park? Ask the cab driver or a senior student. Ilorin has several.
Board only at recognised motor parks. The state government is cracking down on illegal roadside parks.
It is a trip across town, not across campus. Leave extra time, especially before a lecture or exam.
Agree the fare with the driver before you get in, and tell them the exact name: "UITH", "Old College" or "New College".
known: The New Park is at the Main Gate on University Road, beside the Unilorin Zoo (Google Maps listing). Campus shuttles and buses leave from there to the Permanent Site Bus Terminus.
On campus, university buses were reported at ₦100 to campus from the new park, and Tanke Terminus to campus at ₦200 (late 2025).
note: Not yet confirmed on the ground: the exact boarding spot at the Gate, which town motor park serves UITH, the Old College or the New College, the route, and current fares. To be checked on the field trip.
steps: Go to the New Park at the Main Gate, beside the Unilorin Zoo. This is where cabs, buses and tricycles pick up and drop off. Tap "New Park (Main Gate)" on the Main Campus map to see it.
Take a cab from there to the motor park in town that serves your destination.
At that motor park, board a vehicle going to UITH, the Old College or the New College.
